DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図をお渡しします。どの門からお戻りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll give you a map. Which gate do you plan to return through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 南門から入って、一時間ぐらい歩いて、六時半ごろ同じ門から出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 戻る予定時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to enter through the south gate, walk for about an hour, and leave through the same gate at around six thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your planned return time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この南門は六時に閉まります。六時半には使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This south gate closes at six. You cannot use it at six thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口が開いているから、帰りも開いていると思っていました。六時半に出られる門はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 門の閉鎖時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since the entrance was open, I assumed it would still be open when I left. Is there a gate I can leave through at six thirty?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the gate's closing time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 東側の出口をご利用できます。南門からは、園内の池を回って向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the exit on the east side. From the south gate, go around the pond inside the park to reach it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこを知らずに南門へ戻ると、遠回りになりそうですね。地図に帰る道を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉門後も同じ門へ戻る案を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I went back to the south gate without knowing that, it looks as though I'd have to make a detour. Could you mark my way out on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Revise your plan to return to the same gate after closing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この分岐で池の東側へ進み、こちらの出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. At this fork, go along the east side of the pond toward this exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。東出口まで歩く余裕がなければ、散歩を短くして六時前に南門へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の帰路を地図で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. If I won't have enough time to walk to the east exit, I'll shorten my walk and return to the south gate before six.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the alternative route out on the map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合は時間に余裕を持ってください。閉門の案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, please allow plenty of time. Check the gate-closing notices as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南門に戻るなら早めに、長く歩くならこの東出口へ。出発前に同行者にも帰路を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉門までに通り抜けるか短縮する方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I return to the south gate, I'll do so early; if I take a longer walk, I'll use this east exit. I'll tell my companions our return route before we set off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to get through before the gate closes or shorten your walk. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。この地図をお持ちください。お選びになった出口へ向かう道を確かめながらお歩きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take this map and check the route to your chosen exit as you walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの出口をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which exit are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 北側のバス乗り場です。ベビーカーを押しているので、階段を使わずに行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカー利用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bus stops on the north side. I'm pushing a stroller, so I'd like to get there without using stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are using a stroller. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目の前の北口は階段です。エレベーターなら、反対側の連絡通路へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The north exit right in front of you has stairs. For the elevator, go to the connecting passage on the opposite side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: エレベーターで下りると南側に出ますか。その場合、バス乗り場から離れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い出口の段差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Will I come out on the south side if I take the elevator down? That would put me farther from the bus stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about steps at the nearest exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。地上に出てから駅の東側の道を回ると、北側へ行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Once you reach ground level, you can get to the north side by going around the east side of the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し遠くても、ベビーカーを持って階段を上り下りするより、その道にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: エレベーター経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if it's a little farther, I'll take that route rather than carry the stroller up and down the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the route using the elevator. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東側の道には交差点があります。地図のこちらの横断歩道をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is an intersection on the east-side road. Please use this crosswalk on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: エレベーターを下りて東側へ回り、横断歩道を渡るんですね。途中でも段差の少ない道を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地上で目的側へ戻る道を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I take the elevator down, go around to the east side, and cross at the crosswalk. Can I choose a route with fewer steps along the way too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm how to get back to the destination side at ground level. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この地図の経路は歩道の切れ目を通ります。現地の通行状況もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The route on this map goes through openings in the sidewalk. Please also check the actual access conditions there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。近い階段出口ではなく、エレベーターと地上の道を使って北側へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 距離より段差の少なさを優先して選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll head to the north side using the elevator and the road at ground level instead of the nearby stairway exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a route by prioritizing fewer steps over distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。この地図をお持ちになり、まず奥のエレベーターの表示へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. Take this map and first follow the elevator signs farther inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の手続きをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to register a move into the city?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しましたが、同じ市内です。しかも同じ建物で、二〇一号室から三〇二号室へ移りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋番号が変わった転居を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved, but within the same city. In fact, it's the same building: I moved from room 201 to room 302.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your move with a change of room number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 市外から来られたのではなく、建物内で住む部屋が変わったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you haven't moved here from outside the city; you've changed rooms within the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。住所の町名と番地は同じです。入口にあった転入の用紙を使っていいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市外からの転入ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The town name and street number in my address are unchanged. I'm not sure whether I can use the move-in form that was at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not moved in from outside the city. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届の種類を担当が確認しますので、その用紙に書き始める前に窓口でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check which type of notification you need, so consult the counter before you start filling out that form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しい部屋番号だけ伝えるより、旧室と新室を両方書いたメモを見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使う届の種類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. Rather than just give my new room number, I'd like to show a note listing both the old and new rooms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which type of notification to use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それが分かりやすいです。引っ越した日もあわせてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will make it clear. Please also tell them the date you moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十月一日に移りました。町名と番地は同じ、旧室二〇一、新室三〇二、とメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧室と新室を区別して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I moved on October first. I've noted that the town name and street number are the same, the old room was 201, and the new room is 302.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clearly distinguish the old and new rooms. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの住所異動の窓口へどうぞ。用紙と必要な確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please go to this address-change counter. They will explain the form and the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 市外からの転入とは言わず、同じ建物の別室へ移ったことを説明して、合う用紙をもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で用紙を確認して記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that I moved to a different room in the same building, rather than say I moved in from another city, and get the appropriate form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the form at the counter before filling it out. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。そのメモをお持ちになって窓口へお進みください。用紙の種類を確認してからご記入いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Take that note to the counter. You can fill out the form after confirming which type it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更の結果は、登録された番号へお電話する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We plan to call your registered number with the result of your appointment-change request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その番号は先月解約しました。変更の返事を待っていましたが、その電話では受けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録された連絡先は解約済みで返事を受けられないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I canceled that number last month. I've been waiting for the reply about the change, but I can't receive it on that phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the registered contact number has been canceled and you cannot receive the reply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しくお使いの番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a new number you are using?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。こちらです。前の番号から自動で転送されると思って、受付への変更を忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番号を示し自動転送と思って変更を忘れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. I thought calls would automatically be forwarded from my old number, so I forgot to update it with reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the new number and explain that you forgot to update it because you assumed calls would be forwarded automatically. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの連絡先も確認して訂正する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check and correct the contact details here as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。予約の変更が済んだということではなく、まず結果を受ける番号を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約変更の確定と連絡先訂正を分けて依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't mean that the appointment change is complete; first I'd like to correct the number where I will receive the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the contact correction separately from confirmation of the appointment change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。新しい番号は、この末尾四桁で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Are these the correct last four digits of your new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、二八六一です。知らない人が前の番号を使っているかどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新番号の末尾を照合し旧番号の利用者は不明だと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, 2861. I don't know whether someone I don't know is now using my old number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Verify the new number's last digits and add that you do not know who uses the old number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 前の番号については、確認できていない点として伺います。連絡済みかも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll note that the situation with the old number is unconfirmed. I'll also ask the staff whether they have already tried contacting you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい番号を登録したら、結果がまだ未確認なことも伝えてください。変更日を決めたとは会社へ言わず、返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認の変更結果を新番号へ案内してほしいと頼み会社へ確定報告を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: After registering my new number, please also tell them I still haven't confirmed the result. I won't tell my company the changed date is settled; I'll wait for the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the unconfirmed change result to be sent to the new number and hold off on reporting it as confirmed to your company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡先の訂正と、予約変更の返答状況を分けて担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the correction of your contact details and the reply status of your appointment change separately with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here because you cannot find your bicycle, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日、駅の西側の歩道に置きました。今朝戻ると、私の自転車がありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐輪場所と紛失状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Yesterday I left it on the sidewalk on the west side of the station. When I returned this morning, my bicycle was gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where you parked and how the bicycle went missing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場所に、撤去などの案内はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were there any notices about removal or similar measures there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありました。案内を写真に撮りましたが、私の自転車が撤去されたかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撤去の案内を見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I photographed the notice, but I haven't yet asked whether my bicycle was removed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw a removal notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、その管理窓口へ確認する必要があります。写真の連絡先をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First you need to check with that management office. Please look at the contact information in your photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。なくなっただけで、すぐ盗まれたと決めてしまわない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 盗難か撤去か未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. Just because it's gone, I shouldn't immediately decide it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed whether it was stolen or removed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現時点では経緯が分かりません。車体の色、登録番号、置いた場所と日時を伝えて照会してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: At present we don't know what happened. Give them the bicycle's color, registration number, and the location, date, and time you left it, and ask them to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色は白で、登録番号の控えもあります。西側の歩道の位置も地図で示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理窓口に照会する情報を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's white, and I have a record of the registration number. I can also show the location on the west-side sidewalk on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the information for your inquiry to the management office. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認結果を聞き、管理窓口で見つからなければ、その結果とあわせて改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Listen to the result of their check. If the management office cannot locate it, come back to consult us with that result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この連絡先に照会します。撤去されていたら受取方法を聞き、該当しなければ結果を持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照会結果に応じて相談を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask using this contact information. If it was removed, I'll ask how to collect it; if there is no matching bicycle, I'll bring the result back for further advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Continue the consultation according to the inquiry result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今お伺いした経過を整理しておきます。照会結果が分かりましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll organize the account you've just given us. Let us know once you have the inquiry result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの書類をお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to send these documents, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。提出先から折らないように指定されています。この小さい封筒だと折る必要がありそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類を折れない条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The recipient has specified that they must not be folded. It looks as though I'd have to fold them to use this small envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the documents must not be folded. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折らずに入る大きさの封筒を使ってください。書類はこの大きさでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use an envelope large enough to hold them without folding. Are the documents this size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、A四です。大きい封筒にすると送れなくなるのではと心配していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい封筒の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, A4. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to send them if I used a larger envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how larger envelopes are handled. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒の大きさや厚さ、重さを確認して発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the envelope's size, thickness, and weight and explain the shipping options.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、折らずに入る封筒を使います。曲がりにくくするため台紙も入れたいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類の寸法を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll use an envelope they fit into without folding. I'd also like to add a backing board to keep them from bending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the dimensions of the documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 台紙を含めた状態で確認します。中身を整えてから窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check it with the backing board included. Bring it to the counter after arranging the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、こちらの予備封筒に台紙と書類を入れます。台紙なしの重さで料金を決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補強材を含む状態で料金を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the board and documents into this spare envelope now. I'll make sure the postage isn't determined from the weight without the board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to check the postage with the reinforcement included. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。封をした状態で測りますので、宛先もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll measure it sealed, so please write the address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 折らずに入りました。台紙も入れて封をし、宛先を書きました。この状態で発送方法と料金をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 梱包後の封筒を受付へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: They fit without folding. I've included the board, sealed the envelope, and written the address. Please tell me the shipping method and price for it in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand the packed envelope to the counter staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。完成した封筒をお預かりし、大きさと重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll take the finished envelope and check its size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座の開設ですね。どのような目的で使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to open a new account. What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さな修理の仕事を自分で始めるので、お客様からの売上を管理する口座を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開設の利用目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm starting a small repair business on my own, so I'd like advice on an account for managing sales payments from customers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the intended use of the new account. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社からの給与を受け取るためではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it isn't for receiving a salary from a company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分の生活費用の口座と分けたいです。仕事の売上を受け取る用途を先に伝えたいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給与用ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I'd like to keep it separate from my account for living expenses. I thought I should explain first that it will be used for receiving business sales payments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that the account is not for salary payments. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用目的とお仕事の状況を確認し、担当者が申込方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the purpose and the circumstances of your work, and the staff member will explain how to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普通の給与用の案内だけで申し込むのではなく、仕事用として確認してもらうんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自営の入金用だと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So instead of applying based only on the usual guidance for a salary account, I'll have you check it as an account for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add that it will receive payments from self-employment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。必要な資料も確認します。事業の内容が分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll also check the required documents. Do you have anything showing the nature of your business?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 作業の内容と屋号を書いた案内があります。ただ、これだけで足りるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な確認を担当へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a leaflet describing the work and giving my business name. But I don't know whether that alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to carry out the necessary checks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へ見せてください。追加の資料が必要かどうかをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show it to the staff member. They will tell you whether any additional documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内を見せ、売上入金用であることを説明します。必要な資料がそろってから申請を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認資料を聞いてから申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show this leaflet and explain that the account is for sales receipts. I'll proceed with the application after I have all the required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask about supporting documents before applying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。開設を担当する窓口へおつなぎしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll refer you to the counter that handles account opening, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このジュースはいくらですか。下の札は百円ですが、札の商品名と瓶の名前が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商品の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: How much is this juice? The label underneath says 100 yen, but the product name on the label differs from the name on the bottle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the price of the product. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの瓶は、隣の棚の商品です。何かの時に、この棚へ移されたようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This bottle belongs on the next shelf. It seems to have been moved to this shelf at some point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐ下にある札が、その瓶の値段とは限らないんですね。正しい札を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚札の名前との違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the label directly underneath isn't necessarily the price of that bottle. I'd like to see the correct label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the difference from the shelf label's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。この瓶は百八十円で、百円の特売は別の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here it is. This bottle is 180 yen; the 100-yen special is a different product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三本買うつもりでしたが、百八十円なら一本にします。味はこの瓶の方が好きなので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい売り場の札を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to buy three, but at 180 yen I'll take one. I prefer the flavor of this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the label at the correct sales location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かしこまりました。残りの二本はこちらの棚でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We'll take the other two here on this shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。元の特売の棚には戻さず、この商品名の札がある所へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格を聞いて購入数を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll return them to the spot with this product's name on the label, rather than the original special-offer shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change the quantity you will buy after hearing the price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらが正しい場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. This is the correct spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一本をかごに入れました。買うのは百円の商品ではなく、百八十円のこのジュースです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻す商品を正しい棚へ返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put one in my basket. I'm buying this juice at 180 yen, rather than the 100-yen product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the items you are not buying to the correct shelf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できましたね。選ばれた一本をレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've confirmed it now. Please take the one you've chosen to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇をご覧になっているのですね。この細い道は管理作業用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the flowerbed. This narrow path is for maintenance work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 花を近くから撮りたいのですが、ここへ入ってもいいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 細い道へ入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to photograph the flowers from close up. May I go in here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may enter the narrow path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一般の方は入れません。見学は、幅の広い遊歩道からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It isn't open to the public. Please view the flowers from the wide walking path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。奥の黄色い花を大きく写したくて、近道を探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮りたい花と目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I was looking for a shortcut because I wanted a large close-up of the yellow flowers at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which flowers you want to photograph and your purpose. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 黄色い花は、花壇の東側からも見えます。遊歩道がそちらを回っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also see the yellow flowers from the east side of the flowerbed. The walking path goes around that side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 東側なら、柵の外から近く見られるんですね。管理用の道を通らずに行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理用の道と遊歩道を見分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: From the east side I can see them close up from outside the fence, then. Can I get there without using the maintenance path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the maintenance path from the walking path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この広い道をそのまま回ってください。花壇の中へは足を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Just follow this wide path around. Please do not step into the flowerbed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その道から撮ります。花だけを大きく撮れなくても、周りを含めた写真に変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遊歩道側の撮影位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take photos from that path. Even if I can't get a big close-up of just the flowers, I'll change to a composition that includes the surroundings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to take photos from the walking path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三脚をお使いになる場合は、通行する人のために道幅を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you use a tripod, please leave enough path width for people to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は手持ちです。遊歩道の端で立ち止まり、人が来たら譲って撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇に入らず構図を変えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm shooting handheld today. I'll stop at the edge of the walking path and give way when someone comes along while taking photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will change the composition without entering the flowerbed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。東側の遊歩道からどうぞ。管理用の道の入口は空けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please use the east-side walking path. Keep the entrance to the maintenance path clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この列車にお乗りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to take this train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。十時二十分とあるので、その時刻に改札へ来ればよいと思いました。同行者はまだ駅へ来ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車時刻を改札到着時刻と思い同行者が未到着だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says 10:20, so I thought I just needed to get to the ticket gates at that time. My companion hasn't arrived at the station yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the train time for the time to reach the gates and that your companion has not arrived. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十時二十分は列車の出発時刻です。改札からホームへの移動もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: 10:20 is the train's departure time. You also need time to get from the ticket gates to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同行者は、十時二十分に駅の入口へ着くと言っています。その列車を待たせることはできませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者の入口到着予定と列車出発は両立しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion says they'll reach the station entrance at 10:20. We can't make that train wait for us, can we?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that your companion's planned entrance arrival is incompatible with the train's departure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人がそろう時刻と、乗車する列車を分けて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's think separately about the time you will both be together and the train you will take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は先に乗らず、改札の外で合流します。次の列車の時刻を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に乗らず改札外で合流し次の列車時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't get on ahead of them; I'll meet them outside the ticket gates. Please show me the next train's departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will meet outside the gates without boarding first, and ask the next train time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は十時四十分の案内です。当日の運行表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next one is listed for 10:40. Please also check today's service display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者へ、十時二十分は待合せ時刻、列車は十時四十分の予定と伝えます。入口もこの東口と指定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流時刻と出発予定を分け具体的な入口も同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my companion that 10:20 is our meeting time and that we plan to take the 10:40 train. I'll specify this east entrance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion the meeting time and planned departure separately, specifying the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流後は、余裕を持ってホームへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've met up, please allow plenty of time to get to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合流が遅れたら十時四十分にも必ず乗れるとは言わず、そろってから表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流が遅れた場合は乗車を確約せず表示を再確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: If we're late meeting, I won't say we're certain to catch the 10:40 either; we'll check the display once we're together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if the meeting is delayed, you will not guarantee boarding and will check the display again. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。待合せと出発の時刻を区別して、お二人でご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please distinguish the meeting time from the departure time when the two of you travel.
